name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Mirror Acrylic LED Light with Wooden Base
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality 2-layer acrylic paired with a wooden LED base, combining elegant display appeal with soft ambient lighting.
    - Built with Layer 1 acrylic at 2mm thickness, creating the main printed surface of the design.
    - Features Layer 2 mirror acrylic at 3mm thickness, adding a premium reflective effect and engraved decorative detail.
    - Comes with a sturdy wooden base designed with a through-slot structure for stable display and light transmission.
    - The LED wooden base is USB powered, making it convenient for desks, shelves, bedside tables, and display areas.
    - Available mirror acrylic finishes:
             +) Gold Mirror Acrylic
             +) Silver Mirror Acrylic 
    Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple design sizes shown:
              +) 5.91  x 5.91 in ~ 15 x 15 cm with 15 cm base
              +) 7.87 x 7.87 in ~ 20 x 20 cm with 20 cm base
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed. 
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing on layer 1 acrylic for clear details, vivid colors, and a clean decorative finish.
    - The layer 2 mirror acrylic is finished with engraving to create a refined and premium reflective effect.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized acrylic sign and a decorative LED light display.
    - Designed for desks, shelves, bedside tables, classrooms, offices, and decorative corners.
    - The layered acrylic structure creates a premium display effect even when the light is off.
    - When illuminated, the engraved mirror acrylic and printed acrylic combine to create a stylish glowing presentation.
    - Suitable for personalized gifts, teacher appreciation gifts, room décor, event keepsakes, and celebration displays.
    - Great for adding warmth, personality, and a modern decorative touch to any indoor space.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for teachers, couples, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Teacher Appreciation Day, weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, holidays, graduation gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves custom décor, LED display pieces, and meaningful keepsakes.
    - Great for classroom décor, bedroom décor, office desks, and personalized event displays.
    - A beautiful gift that combines lighting, personalization, and elegant layered design.
    - Adds a warm, stylish, and memorable touch to any space ✨🎁

 

  • LED Light Features:
    - USB powered for convenient everyday use.
    - Available with monochrome lighting or 7-color LED lighting, depending on the selected option.
    - 7 LED colors include: red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, purple, and white.
    - Can display fixed single-color light or colorful gradient mode.
    - Supports fast and slow color-changing modes.
    - Includes brightness adjustment:
              +) Press “+” or “-” to adjust brightness
              +) Press the middle button to turn on/off
    - Features a memory function, remembering the last brightness level and light color used.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Mirror Acrylic LED Light with Wooden Base

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
